Evaluation and Comparison Workflows
|-- Pin the meaning of each run
|   |-- EvalPromptService -> versioned workflow prompts
|   |   |-- Validate stages, template variables, references and parent lineage
|   |   |-- Save changed content as a new version; reject stale baseVersion
|   |   `-- resolve(promptId, version) -> exact stage text + hash + cited reference text
|   |       `-- Authoring defaults are saved explicitly; execution only substitutes variables
|   |-- EvalRunService.prepare -> durable run inputs
|   |   |-- Workflow + prompt versions + model + effort + independent sample count
|   |   |-- AgentContext -> immutable ID + contentHash
|   |   |   `-- Resolve source content for generation; fail if its hash changed
|   |   |-- Canvas inputs -> CompareSessionService.capture [shared capture]
|   |   |-- Optional references, layout template and earlier alternatives -> pinned copies
|   |   `-- Rerun -> reuse matching pins and retain the original root run's AgentContext
|   `-- [shared capture] CompareCanvasCopy
|       |-- Source identity: documentId + optional viewId + checkpointId
|       |-- copyCompareHistory -> selected checkpoint + required diagram revisions
|       |   |-- New history context; baseline and head point to the selected checkpoint
|       |   `-- Empty undo/redo lists; revision boundaries retain external ancestry references
|       `-- Clone presentation and provenance; reject unavailable or changed selections
|           `-- Runs and comparisons retain independent copies of the same shared canvas model
|-- Execute pinned workflows -- EvalRunService
|   |-- requestId + request hash -> reuse the same run or reject conflicting reuse
|   |-- Cells normally expand as prompt x sample x workflow stage
|   |   |-- Save queued run before starting background generation
|   |   |-- Independent prompt/sample chains: default concurrency 3
|   |   `-- Session context delivery: one chain at a time within the run
|   |-- Workflow dispatch
|   |   |-- roll-up: pinned child + parent -> r2 -> g2
|   |   |   |-- r2: materialize one compressed diagram
|   |   |   |-- g2: use validated r2 to attach into a copy of the parent history
|   |   |   `-- r2 fails -> mark g2 skipped
|   |   |-- alternatives: AgentContext + optional earlier outputs -> new canvas
|   |   |   `-- Optional layout template -> fill its slots through the template materializer
|   |   |-- few-shot-refinement: context + target + single-diagram template
|   |   |   `-- Five synthetic reference slots -> three alternatives per round
|   |   |       `-- Three evaluated rounds -> one progress Judgement
|   |   |-- diagram-change-proposal: context -> exact proposalTree + display canvas
|   |   |   `-- Preserve tree syntax errors for deterministic assessment
|   |   |-- linked-canvases: context + optional canvas set -> frozen linked output bundle
|   |   `-- diagram-history: external history runner owns plan/execute steps
|   |       `-- Cells reference timelineId + stepId in the shared history store
|   |-- Runtime boundary
|   |   |-- File-based input -> CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   `-- Session-delivered context -> AgentContextEvalRuntime
|   |       |-- Resolve context before opening an independent persisted session
|   |       |-- Shared prefix cache key; separate audit IDs and sample answers
|   |       `-- Return output + usage + execution identity; dispose session on every exit
|   `-- generateValidated -> materializer/validator -> accept or retry
|       |-- Validation failure -> previous-output.json + validation-error.json
|       |   `-- At most 3 generation attempts; accumulate usage across attempts
|       `-- Runtime failure, exhausted validation or cancellation -> terminal cell status
|-- Retain outputs using shared canvas and revision types
|   |-- Single-canvas materializers -> CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |   |-- saveMappingDiagram(type=generated) -> project representation catalog
|   |   |-- GeneratedCanvas provenance: run, cell, prompt, context, sample and stage
|   |   `-- Run pins canvasId + checkpointId + output snapshot + placement snapshot
|   |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog -> completed, settled generated canvases
|   |   |-- Storage is in the project catalog, outside the Mapping workspace
|   |   `-- Checkpoint reads first consult retained run/history snapshots
|   |-- materializeLinkedCanvases -> EvalOutputResult
|   |   |-- Clone existing histories; materialize new diagrams with shared controllers
|   |   |-- Require every input canvas exactly once and unique output canvas IDs
|   |   |-- Validate edits, jump endpoints, visible source spans and target concepts
|   |   |-- Require every canvas reachable from rootCanvas
|   |   `-- Replace old jump lists -> freeze complete bundle in run.outputResults[cellKey]
|   |       `-- Baselines + proposed documents + diagram revisions + placement snapshot
|   |-- captureOutputResult -> pin a completed change-session proposal
|   |   |-- Check project, session version and an unoccupied eligible output cell
|   |   `-- Attach the frozen result without accepting changes or starting generation
|   `-- recordLegacy / migrate -> reconcile chat alternatives and older roll-ups
|       `-- Retain original checkpoints and chat identities; replay through original executor
|-- Compare retained outputs -- CompareSessionService / ComparisonGenerationService
|   |-- Manual selection -> [shared capture] -> createPinned -> saved comparison session
|   |   |-- Whole-canvas panes with camera/focus pairs
|   |   `-- Diagram panes with exact revision IDs and optional ranges or subtree targets
|   |-- Model comparison -> capture inputs before generation
|   |   |-- Pin diagram ASCII, revision IDs, evaluator prompt and prompt version
|   |   |-- Ordinary comparison -> validate generated pairs
|   |   |   |-- Known diagrams, in-bounds slices and distinct alternatives
|   |   |   `-- Every selected alternative represented -> createPinned from captured copies
|   |   `-- Experiment comparison -> resolve and persist a comparison report
|   `-- JudgementService -> independently typed durable assessments
|       |-- Reconcile manual sessions and model jobs into diagram/canvas comparisons or reports
|       |-- Store native few-shot progress and deterministic diagram-change-tree results
|       |-- Subjects point to source snapshots and, when resolved, runId + outputKey
|       `-- A Judgement owns its attachments and may assess outputs from several runs
|-- Organize experiments -- ExperimentService
|   |-- Cases + conditions + phases + samples + stage outputs
|   |   |-- Cases bind AgentContext IDs and optional content hashes
|   |   |-- Stage outputs reference existing run cells for the same case and project
|   |   `-- Comparison Judgements must match the selected phase, cases and conditions
|   |-- Planned generation
|   |   |-- prepareForReview -> pin prompts and inputs without launching a runnable job
|   |   |-- Map every planned cell exactly once -> awaiting-approval
|   |   `-- Recorded approval -> starting -> launchPrepared -> started
|   |       |-- Persist launch progress so the same approval can resume safely
|   |       `-- Approved plans and sample/input assignments remain fixed
|   |-- Deterministic assessment -> read finished cells' retained proposalTree text
|   |   `-- judgeDiagramChangeTrees -> durable Judgement attached to the experiment
|   `-- Relaunch edited output -> immutable prompt fork + new run + next sample attempt
|       `-- Preserve links to the original sample/stage and reuse its pinned inputs
|-- Promote completed evidence -- promoteOutput / prepareOutputPromotion
|   |-- Resolve source from history artifact, frozen output result or pinned canvas checkpoint
|   |-- Select bundle, canvas or diagram -> copy reachable canvas dependencies
|   |   `-- Copy selected diagrams with shared canvas transfer; preserve eval evidence
|   |-- Destination
|   |   |-- new-project -> new canvas project group and standard canvases
|   |   |-- new-canvas -> standard canvases in the selected destination
|   |   `-- existing-canvas -> copy into a current settled standard destination
|   |       `-- Reject stale revision or unsaved Mapping edits
|   |-- Remap canvas/diagram jump targets and record generated-to-promoted placements
|   |   `-- Reject a partial selection if a dependency links back to an excluded diagram
|   `-- publishOutputPromotion -> project catalog documents + promotion receipt
|       `-- Same requestId/signature returns prior receipt; mismatched reuse conflicts
`-- Keep records navigable and consistent
    |-- Cell states: queued -> generating -> finished / failed / cancelled; dependents may skip
    |   `-- runStatus aggregates cells; mixed finished and unsuccessful cells -> partial
    |-- Serialize progress saves; deletion aborts work and prevents later resurrection
    |-- Server restart
    |   |-- Ordinary active eval cells -> failed; completed canvases retained
    |   |-- Diagram-history runs -> left to their durable external coordinator
    |   `-- Comparison jobs -> recover published session/report, otherwise fail
    `-- EvalsPage -> prompt editor, run outputs, experiments, comparisons and Judgements
        |-- Open the exact prompt version pinned by a run
        |-- Select outputs for comparison; navigate experiment output sequences
        `-- Poll active work and refresh generated outputs as cells complete
